info.title: Acervo platform administration
info.description: Platform A/B/C administration. Atomic institution onboarding and new administrator invitations use owner/type-scoped idempotency. Publication is after commit with explicit recovery and no outbox guarantee. Institution details include current agreement, computed quotas and warnings. Backend completion does not authorize frontend cutover or retirement of compatibility endpoints.

post.description: MFA-verified platform operator with explicit permissions only. No document access or impersonation. Keys are scoped to operator and operation type. Equivalent normalized payload replays the committed result without another publication; conflicting payload is 409. Queue/refresh/outcome persistence failure retains committed identifiers with failed or unknown publication. accepted means transport acceptance, never recipient delivery. Stale pending state is unknown at five minutes; explicit resend rotates generation. Operations are retained for resource lifetime.

post.description: Immediate immutable revision under institution lock. Existing same-plan amendments preserve source snapshot even after catalog withdrawal; switching selects current available plan with expected revision. All changed role limits require matching reasoned exceptions. Whole-peso CLP strings; no tax/payment calculation. Paid agreements require customer identity. Dates are inclusive Santiago days; future/expired contracts do not change access. Block A does not enforce agreed limits.
